title: Quasar: A Programming Language Specialized for LLM Code Actions
abstract: arXiv:2506.12202v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often call external tools to solve tasks. One effective strategy is for LLMs to write code, enabling them to use complex control flow such as conditionals and loops. Such code actions are typically represented as Python code, since LLMs are proficient at writing it. However, many programming language features that would support more effective code actions are difficult to implement for Python. We propose separating internal code that captures program logic from external calls to tools that interact with the world. New features can then easily be implemented by (1) annotating external calls with the effects relevant to that feature, and (2) modifying the execution of the internal code to track this information. translated_title: Quasar：一种专为大型语言模型代码操作设计的编程语言
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）通常调用外部工具来解决问题。一种有效的策略是让LLMs编写代码，使其能够使用复杂的控制流，如条件语句和循环。这类代码操作通常以Python代码表示，因为LLMs擅长编写Python。然而，许多能够支持更有效代码操作的编程语言特性难以在Python中实现。我们提出将捕获程序逻辑的内部代码与调用外部工具进行世界交互的调用分离。新特性可以通过（1）用与该特性相关的效果注释外部调用，以及（2）修改内部代码的执行以跟踪这些信息来轻松实现。我们开发了一种新颖的编程语言Quasar来实现这一想法。为了说明其效用，我们在Quasar之上实现了几个有用的特性以增强代码操作：访问并发...
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为Quasar的新编程语言，通过分离内部逻辑与外部工具调用并跟踪效果，使大型语言模型能够更灵活地生成和执行代码操作。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Quasar, a novel programming language that separates internal logic from external tool calls and tracks effects, enabling LLMs to generate and execute code actions more flexibly.
